lines.en: I spread my web and rise slowly.

lines.zh: 触手一收一放，我往前飘。
lines.en: My arms gather and release, drifting me forward.
I let the water push me; rowing is too much work.

lines.zh: 我像一把伞在水里翻转。
lines.en: I tumble through the water like an umbrella.
One ripple of my rim slides me half a meter.
I drift very slowly; there is no hurrying me.

lines.zh: 触手碰到石头，我改个向。
lines.en: An arm touches rock, so I change direction.

lines.zh: 我把自己折起来，往下沉。
lines.en: I fold myself up and sink down.
The deep water is soft, and I tread through it.
Do not think me slow, I am always moving.

lines.zh: 我顺着海沟的坡滑下去。
lines.en: I slide down the slope of the trench.

lines.zh: 伞膜兜住水，我停了一下。
lines.en: My web catches the water and holds me still.
I drift around a patch of sea anemones.
Only in the dark do I dare open wide.

lines.zh: 我一开一合，像在呼吸着前进。
lines.en: I open and close, moving forward as if breathing.

lines.zh: 沙底太亮，我压低伞沿走。
lines.en: The sand is too bright, so I lower my umbrella edge.

lines.zh: 我借着尾巴的水流滑出去。
lines.en: I ride the current my own body pushed back.

lines.zh: 上面有影子掠过，我贴住石头。
lines.en: A shadow passes above; I cling to the rock.
I hold my umbrella open, hanging in the middle.

lines.zh: 触手上的小刺在轻轻动。
lines.en: The small spines on my arms quiver faintly.
There is a shell on the sand, and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 我把自己团成一朵白花。
lines.en: I curl myself into a white flower.

lines.zh: 水很凉，我的伞边卷起来。
lines.en: The water is cold, so my rim curls inward.

lines.zh: 有一只小虾钻到我伞下。
lines.en: A little shrimp has slipped under my umbrella.
I stay perfectly still, like a scrap of cloth.

lines.zh: 光从上头漏下来，软软的。
lines.en: Light leaks down from above, soft and dim.
I breathe slowly, and my gills stir.
The seabed mud is fine, and I leave it alone.

lines.zh: 我数着自己有几条触手。
lines.en: I count how many arms I have.
The current passes, and I sway twice.

lines.zh: 我把自己摊平，歇一会儿。
lines.en: I flatten myself out and rest a while.

lines.zh: 伞膜里兜着一小团空气。
lines.en: A small pocket of air is caught in my web.

lines.zh: 你从没见过我这样的吧。
lines.en: You have never seen anything like me, have you?
I hold my umbrella up at you, do not be afraid.
Your lamp shines right through my web.
If you reach out, I will close up.

lines.zh: 我撑开伞，从你头顶飘过。
lines.en: I open my web and drift over your head.

lines.zh: 你脚下那片海，本来没我。
lines.en: The sea beneath you had no me before.
You brought me here, and I remember.
You are far gentler than a shark.
I press to your visor and look at myself.
You say nothing, and neither do I.
Ouch! My web has been torn open.
I only have six health, be gentle.
One arm broke off, and it still moves.
I ball myself up, do not come closer.
My blood spreads quickly through the water.
I sink lower, trying to get away from you.

lines.zh: 这一下让我伞都合不上。
lines.en: That blow left my web unable to close.
I am shaking hard and cannot help it.
Do not bite the rim of my web.
I cannot drift anymore, let me recover.
That bit of meat in your hand, for me?
I reach out one arm to try.
The smell is spreading through the water.
I will not chase; drift it over yourself.
The smell of shrimp, I know it.

lines.zh: 你把东西沉下来我就接。
lines.en: Sink it down and I will take it.
I open my web over that lump of food.
This is not enough, bring a little more.
I curl around it slowly, very gently.
When I finish, I will thank you once.
The rim of my web brushes your shoulder.
You move, and I get pushed aside.
We bump together, soft and yielding.
Do not grab, my arms will break.
I hit a stone and flinch inward.
The water squeezes, and my web wrinkles.
Your knee pokes into my belly.
I drifted by, I did not mean to touch you.
This hole is too narrow and I am stuck.
Make way, I cannot fold my umbrella.
His umbrella is a size smaller than mine.
We hold our webs together and turn slowly.
Our arms tangle once, then come apart.
He stirs the water into a fine spiral.
I stop beneath his umbrella.
Two of us drift, neither in any hurry.
In this sea there are only us two.
He touches my rim and I shiver.
We sink downward together.
Small eggs will be left beneath our webs.
I roll up a shell and carry it off.
I tuck that bit of meat under my web.
What you dropped, I pick up with an arm.
Heavy things I cannot drag.
I stick the shiny flake under my web.
What I find belongs to me.

lines.zh: 我用八条手捧着一颗珠。
lines.en: I cradle a bead in all eight arms.
Food should be hidden in a rock crevice.

lines.zh: 我卷得太紧，拿不出来了。
lines.en: I curled too tight and cannot get it out.
This one I keep for slow eating.
That shadow above is circling.
There is the smell of shark, very faint.
A small shrimp swims past my rim.
The water stirs, so I close my web.
Something touched one of my arms.
That dark mass has stopped.
I catch the glint of teeth.

lines.zh: 有人在洞口放了个笼子。
lines.en: Someone left a cage at the cave mouth.
That small noise is not right.
I watch it and do not move yet.

lines.zh: 它绕着我，我数着它的鳍。
lines.en: It circles me, and I count its fins.

lines.zh: 我合起伞，装成一块石头。
lines.en: I close my web and pass for a stone.
It comes closer, so I sink lower.
I tuck my arms under my web to hide.
It lunges, and I give way first.
I spread my web as wide as I can to scare it.
The current changed, so it is about to move.
I press against the rock and stay still.
On its second circle, I get ready to flee.
A little closer and I will jet away.
I lash one arm across it.
This slap is soft, but it sticks.
I wrap its mouth and hold on.
It shakes once, and I go flying.
I plaster my web over its eyes.
Bite me? I bite back.
I shove hard against its nose.
An arm may tear, but I still wrap it.
Its hide is rough, and my suckers slip.
That one left even me dizzy.
This sea had no me to begin with.

lines.zh: 你把我放出来，我就来了。
lines.en: You let me out, so here I am.
The water flashed, and I opened my web.
I land on the sand, my arms still soft.
There is no den for me, so I find one.
My first mouthful of water is cold enough to shiver.
I look up and see an unfamiliar blue.
The place is strange, but the water is fine.
I dropped out of the light into the sea.
Only one was placed, so I am alone.

lines.zh: 水在发烫，我的伞卷起来。
lines.en: The water scalds, and my web curls shut.

lines.zh: 我被摔在甲板上，黏住了。
lines.en: I was dropped on the deck and stuck there.
Out of water, my web collapses.
A bang, and I tumble three times over.
Something passed through my web.

lines.zh: 光一炸，我的触手全僵了。
lines.en: Light bursts, and all my arms go stiff.
Three days hungry, and my web has thinned.

lines.zh: 电在水里跑，我全身发麻。
lines.en: Electricity runs through the water and numbs me.

lines.zh: 这里什么也没有，只有黑。
lines.en: There is nothing here, only black.
